table.name: exhibit
table.remarks: An investigation task can have many exhibits. An exhibit is a physical or digital item collected as evidence during the course of an investigation task.

column.remarks: Primary key. System generated unique key for exhibits. This key should never be exposed to users via any system utilizing the tables.

column.name: task_guid
column.remarks: Foreign key references investigation.task.task_guid. System generated unique key for tasks. This key should never be exposed to users via any system utilizing the tables.

column.name: investigation_guid
column.remarks: Foreign key references investigation.investigation.investigation_guid. Denormalized from task to support querying exhibits at the investigation level. This key should never be exposed to users via any system utilizing the tables.

column.name: exhibit_number
column.remarks: System generated incremental exhibit number, sequential within the task. Generated by the application on insert. Used as the numeric sort key.

column.name: exhibit_display_number
column.remarks: System generated full display number, composed at insert as investigation name - task number - zero-padded exhibit number (e.g. INV26-001234-5-001). Stored to support sorting and searching on the full number. Treated as a snapshot; not recomputed if the investigation name changes.

column.name: property_type
column.remarks: The type of property the exhibit represents. S = Seized, F = Found.

column.name: description_text
column.remarks: A description of the exhibit collected during the investigation task.

column.name: quantity_amount
column.remarks: The optional quantity of the item collected.

column.name: seized_from_first_name
column.remarks: The first name of the person the item was seized from. Populated only when property_type is S (Seized). Captured as contact information for returning the item and is not tied to a party.

column.name: seized_from_last_name
column.remarks: The last name of the person the item was seized from. Populated only when property_type is S (Seized). Captured as contact information for returning the item and is not tied to a party.

column.name: seized_from_address
column.remarks: The address of the person the item was seized from. Populated only when property_type is S (Seized). Captured as contact information for returning the item and is not tied to a party.

column.name: seized_from_phone_number
column.remarks: The phone number of the person the item was seized from. Populated only when property_type is S (Seized). Captured as contact information for returning the item and is not tied to a party.

column.name: collected_by_app_user_guid_ref
column.remarks: Unenforced foreign key references shared.app_user_guid. GUID representing the officer that collected the exhibit. Defaults to the logged in user at time of creation. This key should never be exposed to users via any system utilizing the tables.

column.name: location_of_intake_text

column.name: property_tag_number
column.remarks: The property tag number assigned to the exhibit.
